race.comment: Tough race. COVERT THINKING (4) is going well, a winner here two back before being well backed at Cranbourne in tougher and boxing on well for third. Back a grade now and looks hard to beat. CALLMEANICON (9) was much better second up at Caulfield Heath to 1800m and looks ready to peak third up. Gets to her right trip now and draws softly. SALSITA (8) doesn't win out of turn and is back from 3080m but the run two back at Mornington has him right in the mix and he'll be staying on. NAVY HEART (10) hasn't fired a shot in two runs back but can be a sharp improver to this trip third up, look for a market push.
